title: Out of the Deep I Call
description: Out of the Deep I Call in Tonic Solfa to ST. BRIDE, doh is Bb: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 4 verses and a piano.
about: Henry Williams Baker wrote these words. They were printed in the Evangelical Lutheran Hymn-Book (St. Louis, 1927), as hymn 423.
The book printed the words without tunes, marked Short Metre (6.6.8.6), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to ST. BRIDE; any other Short Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: Out of the deep I call To Thee, O Lord, to Thee; Be-fore Thy throne of grace I fall, Be mer-ci-ful to me.

lines: Out of the deep I call
To Thee, O Lord, to Thee;
Before Thy throne of grace I fall,
Out of the deep I cry,
Of evil done in days gone by,
Out of the deep of fear
From morning watch till night is near
Before Thy throne of grace I bow;

licence: Public domain: Henry Williams Baker died in 1877.
credits: Words by Henry Williams Baker (1821–1877), public domain, as printed in the Evangelical Lutheran Hymn-Book (1927); set to ST. BRIDE by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
